summary.value: A single TDLR Air Conditioning and Refrigeration contractor licence covers the whole state. No separate municipal contractor licence is named on the board's pages.
summary.source_title: Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Contractors Homepage — TDLR
summary.evidence: Contractors who install, repair, or maintain systems related to air conditioning, refrigeration, or heating must have a TDLR license

jurisdiction_model.local_layer_note: TDLR publishes a knowledge-base page titled 'Out-of-State and Municipal Licenses' which was not read in this pass; municipalities issue permits and may register contractors even where they do not license them. Treat 'state_only' as 'the licence is issued by the state', never as 'no city will ask you for anything'.

boards.scope: HVAC/refrigeration contractor licences and technician registrations, statewide

licence_types.name: Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Contractor — Class A

who_must_hold.value: Any person contracting to install, repair or maintain air conditioning, refrigeration or heating systems; each permanent company location must employ a licensed ACR contractor.
who_must_hold.source_title: Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Contractors Homepage — TDLR
who_must_hold.evidence: ACR companies must employ an ACR contractor in each permanent location

fee.source_title: Renew an Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Contractor License — TDLR
fee.note: The $74 figure is printed in the class-upgrade section of the renewal page. It is the ACR examination fee, but the initial-application page does not repeat it, so confidence is medium, not high.

exam.note: All application requirements including the exam must be completed within one year of filing.

requirement.value: 48 months of practical ACR work under a licensed ACR contractor within the past 72 months.
requirement.source_title: Apply for an Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Contractor License — TDLR
requirement.evidence: at least 48 months of practical experience in air-conditioning and refrigeration-related work

alternatives.value: Technician certification held for 12 months plus 36 months of practical experience within the past 48 months; or a degree/diploma/certification in ACR, a mechanical-engineering degree or licence, military ACR training, or employment by an industrial operation.
alternatives.source_title: Apply for an Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Contractor License — TDLR
alternatives.evidence: You have held a technician certification for the past 12 months

expiry_rule.evidence: Licenses are valid for a period of 1 year from the date of issue.
expiry_rule.note: Expiry = issue date + 12 months, per licence. The rules engine derives it from the licence's own issue date; there is no state-wide common expiry date.

grace_period.value: None for practising. Late renewal is possible but the licence is not valid meanwhile.
grace_period.source_title: Renew an Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Contractor License — TDLR
grace_period.evidence: You may not engage in air conditioning and refrigeration contracting if your license has expired.

late_fee.value: 1.5x the renewal fee if expired 90 days or less; 2x if expired more than 90 days and under 18 months; 2x with executive-director approval from 18 months to 3 years.
late_fee.source_title: Renew an Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Contractor License — TDLR

required.note: No bond requirement appears on the TDLR ACR apply, renew, CE or reciprocity pages, all four of which were read in full. This is recorded as 'not established', NOT as 'no bond required' — the difference matters to a contractor bidding a job.

per_location_rule.value: Per permanent location, not per company.
per_location_rule.source_title: Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Contractors Homepage — TDLR
per_location_rule.note: This is the field that turns a Texas branch opening into a licensing event. A roll-up that acquires a second Texas branch needs a second licensed ACR contractor there, not just a second address.

entity_registration.note: Secretary-of-State registration requirements were not read in this pass; they are a Texas SOS matter, not a TDLR one.

change_notification_deadline.note: No deadline for replacing a departed ACR contractor of record appears on the TDLR ACR pages read.

typical_timeline.note: TDLR publishes no end-to-end processing time for an ACR contractor licence. The only published duration is the criminal-history review: 'a review can take from one to six weeks to complete'. Quoting that as the licence timeline would be wrong, so the field stays empty and the playbook says so.

coverage_notes: Technician registration and technician certification (the credentials most of a Texas HVAC roster actually holds) are NOT populated in this record. Only the two contractor licence classes are. A customer tracking 40 Texas technicians will get renewal maths for their two contractor licences and nothing for the technicians until the wave-2 pass.
Endorsements (Environmental Air Conditioning, Commercial Refrigeration, Process Cooling/Heating) are described in the scope notes but are not modelled as separate trackable objects.
